card.summary: Unlimited assets + unlimited documents on Free; 100 GB CDN bandwidth/month (no overage)

free_tier.stated: Unlimited assets + unlimited documents on Free; 100 GB CDN bandwidth/month (no overage)

egress.terms: 100 GB/month built-in CDN bandwidth, hard cap on Free ('100 GB (no overages)'). Served via images.prismic.io with imgix-style transform params.

record.tooling: Prismic REST API + GraphQL, `@prismicio/client`, slice-machine CLI; assets public at images.prismic.io/<repo>/<id>.<ext>?w=&auto=format,compress
record.chaining: Unlimited assets per repository, bandwidth-capped. Repositories are the unit; creating additional repos is free and each carries its own 100 GB/mo meter. That is a genuine N x 100 GB bandwidth multiplier, with storage effectively unbounded in each.
record.limits_note: Per-asset size cap not published on the pricing page (needs verification in the repo settings); 100 GB/month bandwidth hard stop; Free has 1 repository per... verify. Documents unlimited.
record.reliability_note: Hard bandwidth stop at 100 GB with no paid overage on Free; assets remain stored and resume serving next month.
